units.text: Ruling on one who is unable to fulfill a vow

I was in a gathering with my colleagues, and I swore by Allah that if my brother came, I would slaughter a sheep. My brother came, and at that time I was in hardship and did not have the price of a sheep. What should I do?

If it becomes easy for you, you slaughter the sheep. If the sheep becomes easy for you, you slaughter it, fulfilling your vow. You slaughter it with the intention of giving it to the poor. You give it to the poor, with the intention that you and your household may eat from it. You and your household may eat from it, if you have no intention; you give it to the poor, you do not eat from it.
